params.body:
One rule for photo URLs: the row says what lies in the bucket, the URL points at that, and nothing is checked against S3 or built while a page renders.

- New column vehicle_photos.media_set: the generation of derived sizes present for the photo (VehicleImageService::SET; 1 = sm in the original's format, 2 = sm as WebP). The migration marks every row that already has a media_version as generation 1.
- VehicleImageService::url(): derived sizes exist (version + set) -> signed bucket URL for the file of that generation; no derived sizes yet -> the plain file itself (the upload's thumbnail file for a thumb, else the original), signed, from the bucket. The app route is no longer used for views on S3; it stays for old links and local disks. SM_WEBP_SINCE is gone.
- Every writer of media_version also writes media_set = SET (upload job, blur job, image controller, backfill). stocklist:fotos-afgeleid --maat=<size> selects rows below the current generation, creates the size and stamps the row, so the URLs switch per photo as the run progresses.
- Tests pin: generation 1 -> -sm.jpg/png, generation 2 -> -sm.webp, version without set counts as 1, no version -> the original.
- Needs php artisan migrate on staging after merge; on production it is part of cutover step 2 (CUTOVER.md updated).

Why: #161 bridged old rows through the app route, which built WebP on first request; 69 thumbnails at once saturated PHP-FPM and the detail page answered 504 (#169 was the stopgap).
params.title: Photos: derived generations in the row, URLs follow, no builds while rendering
